# Wingman brand mark

**Provenance:** generated by the owner with an image model on 2026-09-17.
Owned by the project, MIT licensed like the rest of the repo (see
[`LICENSE`](../../LICENSE)).

`source/wingman-logo-source.png` is the untouched source: one 1254x1254
canvas holding two marks side by side, left the gradient primary mark, right
the same mark in near-white monochrome, both already carrying real alpha
transparency (verified pixel-by-pixel; no background keying was needed).
`wingman-mark.png` and `wingman-mark-mono.png` are each mark cropped to its
own tight bounding box (a few stray single-value alpha noise pixels in the
source were thresholded out before computing the box), padded by 7% and
resized to a 1024x1024 square canvas.

## Files

| File | What |
|---|---|
| `source/wingman-logo-source.png` | Untouched two-up source image |
| `wingman-mark.png` | Primary mark: cyan-to-indigo gradient wing with a four-point sparkle, 1024x1024, transparent background |
| `wingman-mark-mono.png` | Monochrome mark for small sizes and dark backgrounds, near-white, 1024x1024, transparent background |

## Palette

| Role | Hex | Sampled from |
|---|---|---|
| Wing gradient start (cyan) | `#30D8ED` | top tip of `wingman-mark.png` |
| Wing gradient end (indigo) | `#523AF0` | bottom tip of `wingman-mark.png` |
| Sparkle | `#BDEAFA` | the four-point star, pale cyan-white |
| Monochrome fill | `#FCFBFB` | `wingman-mark-mono.png`, near-white by design for dark backgrounds |

The tray/app `.ico` (`assets/icon.ico`) and the packaged MSIX logos
(`Square44x44Logo`, `Square150x150Logo`, `StoreLogo`) are both derived from
`wingman-mark.png`; see `packaging/Wingman.Common.psm1`'s `Build-Logos`.
